name: Martha Kelly
bio: Martha Kelly is an American stand-up comedian best known for co-starring in the FX comedy series Baskets. She currently portrays Laurie on HBO’s Euphoria.

credits.title: Coyote vs. Acme
credits.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

credits.title: Homebodies
credits.overview: In a near future where it literally costs money to leave the house, a burnt-out woman risks fraud when she pays her live-in boyfriend's 'exit toll' to get some alone time.

credits.title: Poetic License
credits.overview: Liz, a former therapist and soon-to-be empty nester, becomes the unexpected point of tension between two inseparable best friends and college seniors, Sam and Ari. Liz is forced to re-examine her life as the boys' friendship unravels in a fierce competition for her affection.

credits.title: Only Worn Once
credits.overview: Darcy (Martha Kelly), a recent divorcee, and her daughter, Megan (Natalie Palamides), sell Darcy’s used wedding dress on the internet to an 18-year-old marrying a much older man. When Darcy’s ex, Don, discovers the sale, a fight ensues. A drag queen (Scarlet Envy) unexpectedly saves the day.

credits.title: Sitting in Bars with Cake
credits.overview: Extrovert Corinne convinces Jane, a shy, talented baker, to commit to a year of bringing cakes to bars, to help her meet people and build confidence. But when Corinne receives a life-altering diagnosis, the pair faces a challenge unlike anything they've experienced before.

credits.title: Indoor Baseball
credits.overview: Noel works at an indoor baseball facility with her father where her day-to-day existence is overshadowed by the curse of her family’s lineage: every family member must hit 100 baseballs everyday or the love of their life will die.

credits.title: Marriage Story
credits.overview: A stage director and an actress struggle through a grueling, coast-to-coast divorce that pushes them to their personal extremes.

credits.title: Corporate Animals
credits.overview: Disaster strikes when the egotistical CEO of an edible cutlery company leads her long-suffering staff on a corporate team-building trip in New Mexico. Trapped underground, this mismatched and disgruntled group must pull together to survive.

credits.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
credits.overview: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

credits.title: Infinity Baby
credits.overview: Owing to a genetic mix-up involving stem cell research, the recently founded company Infinity Baby is able to offer a service for aspiring parents who never want to leave the baby bubble — infants that do not age.
